exposure: Blood pressure categories (normotensive, elevated BP, stage 1 hypertension, stage 2 hypertension)
Blood pressure categories (according to 2017 ACC/AHA criteria)
cohort: 2,232 women with singleton pregnancies in Kaya, Burkina Faso
finding: While elevated blood pressure alone was not significantly associated with adverse outcomes, stage 1 hypertension was associated with increased risk of low birth weight babies and overall maternal or neonatal adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with elevated BP had a 2.05-fold increased risk of delivery via caesarean section compared to normotensive women.
